name: White Dagger
body:
School evocation (light); Level sorcerer/wizard 2, white necromancer 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range 0 ft.
Effect dagger-like beam
Duration 1 min./level (D)
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You create a 1-foot-long beam of pure-white positive energy. This beam sheds light like a torch and may be wielded like a dagger. Attacks with the white dagger are melee touch attacks, and can be thrown as a ranged touch attack. If thrown, the white dagger reappears in your hand at the end of your turn. The dagger deals 1d4 points of positive energy damage + 1 point per two caster levels (maximum +10). If the target is undead or otherwise harmed by positive energy, the damage dice is increased to 1d8. Since the blade is immaterial, your Strength modifier does not apply to the damage.
